CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERRELATEDBASEACCOUNT_TRU
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedBaseAccount AS(
	SELECT
		BTB.CUST_NO AS BaseAccountId
		,BTB.PRIMARY_FLAG AS PrimaryFlag
		,BTB.STATUS AS Status
		,BTB.CIF_NO AS InternalCustomerId
		,'TRU' AS SourceCode
		,BTB.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,BTB.insert_dttm AS InsertDttm
        ,BTBD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.TRU_BASELINK_DELTA BTBD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_BASELINK BTB
	ON BTBD.CUST_NO = BTB.CUST_NO AND BTBD.CIF_NO = BTB.CIF_NO AND BTB.isLatest = '1'
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedBaseAccount FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedBaseAccount;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedBaseAccount_SRC AS (
	SELECT	
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(BaseAccountId, PrimaryFlag, Status, InternalCustomerId)) AS HASHROW
		,BaseAccountId
		,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedBaseAccount
	WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedBaseAccount_TGT AS (
	SELECT	
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(BaseAccountId, PrimaryFlag, Status, InternalCustomerId)) AS HASHROW
		,BaseAccountId
    FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedBaseAccount
	-- WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'TRU'
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedBaseAccount_DELTA AS (
	SELECT
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.BaseAccountId,TGT.BaseAccountId) AS BaseAccountId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedBaseAccount_SRC	SRC
	FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedBaseAccount_TGT	TGT
	ON	SRC.BaseAccountId = TGT.BaseAccountId
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedBaseAccount_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedBaseAccount_DELTA;


---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	[BaseAccountId] = SRC.BaseAccountId
	,[PrimaryFlag] = SRC.PrimaryFlag
	,[Status] = SRC.Status
	,[InternalCustomerId] = SRC.InternalCustomerId
	,[SourceCode] = 'TRU'
	,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,[WorkFlowId] = 0
	,[TaskRunId] = 0
	,[InsertDttm] = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedBaseAccount TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedBaseAccount_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.BaseAccountId = TGT.BaseAccountId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedBaseAccount SRC ON SRC.BaseAccountId = TGT.BaseAccountId;


-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerRelatedBaseAccount (
	[BaseAccountId]
	,[PrimaryFlag]
	,[Status]
	,[InternalCustomerId]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	[BaseAccountId]
	,[PrimaryFlag]
	,[Status]
	,[InternalCustomerId]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedBaseAccount
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedBaseAccount;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedBaseAccount_DELTA;

END
